## What improves for the reader?

Describe the correction or website change and link the relevant public issue.

## What changed?

List the publication edition or public files affected. Explain the origin of any new content or visual.

## Checks

- [ ] I checked the changed public links and reading layout.
- [ ] I kept source status, limitations and attribution accurate.
- [ ] I included no private research, credentials, personal data, review records or channel authoring kits.
- [ ] I described the rights and origin of any material added.
- [ ] I identified changes to a released edition instead of silently replacing its history.

These are review prompts, not a DCO sign-off or separate contributor agreement. Do not use this public form for security details; follow SECURITY.md.
